items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里因与林德布拉德碰撞被罚，失去积分
items.summaryZh: 皮亚斯特里在墨西哥大奖赛首弯与林德布拉德碰撞，赛后收到10秒罚时，最终排名从第七降至第15位，失去积分。
items.summaryEn: Piastri collided with Lindblad at the first corner of the Mexican Grand Prix and received a 10-second post-race penalty, dropping him from seventh to 15th in the final classification and costing him his points finish.
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在F1墨西哥大奖赛中因与阿尔维德·林德布拉德碰撞而受罚，失去了积分完赛的成绩。
迈凯伦与小红牛在首弯相撞，当时皮亚斯特里试图从林德布拉德手中抢下第七位，小红牛赛车一度被顶起后撞上护墙，而皮亚斯特里仍将受损的赛车带回第七名。
两位车手赛后都被召至干事处，皮亚斯特里被处以10秒罚时，最终排名降至第15位。
“81号车（皮亚斯特里）从未完全与41号车（林德布拉德）并排，因此无权占据该弯角，”干事的裁决写道。
“在1号弯，41号车手通过松开刹车来防守自己的位置，但并未将81号车手逼出赛道，在外侧留出了比赛空间——尽管他并无义务这样做。”
“干事们认定，如果81号车手在1号弯后进一步向左移动，碰撞本可避免，即使这意味着在2号弯前驶离赛道。”
皮亚斯特里此前坚称林德布拉德应承担责任。
“我试图从内线切入，然后他非常非常晚地关门，所以我不得不避开他，结果跑到了外侧，”他说。
“所以，我从那里尝试了，显然他把我推得很宽，那一刻我知道我无法完成超车，所以我试图脱身。
“但他把我推得太宽了，我无法再往左走，我们的车轮锁在一起，不幸的是，结果就是这样。”
林德布拉德在媒体活动中不想详细评论这一事件，直到他看到事件的录像。
讽刺的是，皮亚斯特里受罚对林德布拉德的 小红牛 车队在与 阿尔派 争夺制造商第五名的战斗中伤害稍大，因为成绩洗牌意味着 阿尔派 的弗兰科·科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利现在因第七和第九名合计获得八分，而 小红牛 仅因利亚姆·劳森的第八名获得四分——尽管 小红牛 仍领先 29 分。
皮亚斯特里的罚时也意味着奥迪获得一个积分，加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托升至第10名。
detailEn: Oscar Piastri has lost his points finish in Formula 1’s Mexican Grand Prix as a punishment for his collision with Arvid Lindblad.

The McLaren and Racing Bulls came together at the first corner when Piastri tried to take seventh from Lindblad, firing the Racing Bulls briefly into the air and then into the barriers, while Piastri brought his battered car home seventh still.
Both drivers were called to the stewards after the race, where Piastri was given a 10-second time penalty that dropped him to 15th in the final results.
“Car 81 [Piastri] was never fully alongside car 41 [Lindblad] so was not able to claim the right to the corner,” said the stewards’ verdict.
“Through Turn 1, the driver of car 41 defended his position by releasing the brakes, however does not force car 81 off the track, allowing racing room on the outside – which he is not required to do.
“The stewards determined that the collision could have been avoided if the driver of car 81 had moved further to the left after Turn 1, even if this involved leaving the track prior to Turn 2.”
Piastri had been adamant Lindblad was to blame.
“I tried to go up the inside and then he shut the door very, very late, so I had to avoid him and end up on the outside,” he said.
“So, I tried from there and obviously he pushed me pretty wide, and at that point I knew I wasn’t going to complete the overtake, so I was trying to get out.
“But he pushed me so far wide, I couldn’t go any further left and we interlocked wheels and that was the end result unfortunately.”
Lindblad didn't want to comment on the incident in detail during his media commitments until he had seen the footage of the incident.

Ironically Piastri being punished hurts Lindblad’s Racing Bulls team slightly more in its battle with Alpine for fifth in the constructors’ championship as the results shuffle means Alpine’s Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly now take a combined eight points for seventh and ninth while Racing Bulls only gets four for Liam Lawson’s eighth place - though Racing Bulls is still 29 points clear.
The Piastri penalty also means Audi gets a point as Gabriel Bortoleto moves up to 10th.
keyPointsZh: 碰撞发生在首弯，皮亚斯特里尝试超越林德布拉德争夺第七位，小红牛赛车一度被顶起后撞上护墙。
干事裁定皮亚斯特里从未完全与林德布拉德并排，因此无权占据该弯角。
keyPointsEn: The collision occurred at Turn 1 as Piastri tried to take seventh from Lindblad, sending the Racing Bulls briefly into the air and then into the barriers.
The stewards ruled that Piastri was never fully alongside Lindblad and therefore could not claim the right to the corner.

detailZh: F1墨西哥大奖赛创纪录之战的赢家与输家
当F1在墨西哥加冕新王时，一位史上最伟大车手之一的动力单元噩梦却每况愈下
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
用来形容基米·安东内利在2026赛季史无前例地登上权力之巅的溢美之词已快用尽。在墨西哥大奖赛上，F1的新统治者得到了与其赛季表现相称的加冕。
安东内利的夺冠在此时或许已是意料之中的事，但这只会让他的成就更加非凡，而非相反。
人们不可能在想到他的成功时不联想到2025年那段艰难的新秀适应期和车队对他的严厉关爱，当时感觉安东内利的实验确实有可能在夏天前后从悬崖边跌落。是不是太过了、太年轻、太早了？
这些问题在今年被迅速打消，安东内利豪取五连胜，一路走向绝对统治，包括在主场蒙扎从第19位发车的那场令人难忘的逆转之战。
安东内利在墨西哥的加冕仪式，驾驶着一辆已不再具有统治力的赛车，恰如其分地配得上这一时刻。当他的顶级车队对手们几乎都摩拳擦掌时，安东内利却跑出了一场成熟而低调的比赛——唯一令人兴奋的时刻是他在红旗后向夏尔·勒克莱尔发起冲击，抢下第三名。那次超车确保他能在墨西哥著名的领奖台上，在热情沸腾的罗德里格斯兄弟赛道体育场前庆祝自己的首个冠军。
在一个梅赛德斯并未占据上风的周末，这仍是一种书写F1历史新篇章的值得称道的方式。
“最后一圈，我只是收油了，因为我根本看不清赛道。我当时情绪上来了，”安东内利这样描述他含泪锁定冠军的时刻。“我说，‘我就收油吧，不然我在这里会撞车。’”
基米·安东内利与托托·沃尔夫拥抱
安东内利的胜利当然不只属于他个人，而是属于遍布布拉克利、布里克斯沃思以及世界各地F1围场的工程师、机械师和其他工作人员组成的大军。他们是这台机器上的齿轮——这台机器在地面效应时代曾运转不畅，但随着F1在2026年改用全新底盘和动力单元规则，它发起了反击。
特别要提到的是前梅赛德斯人才球探格温·拉格鲁和托托·沃尔夫。拉格鲁在卡丁车赛场上发现了安东内利，并在其12岁时将他带入梅赛德斯青训车手计划，而沃尔夫则说到做到，在安东内利18岁时提拔他接替刘易斯·汉密尔顿。父亲马尔科在直到今天的每一步也都发挥了重要作用。
一路上有过磕碰、瘀伤、断裂的碳纤维部件和不少十几岁少年的泪水。但这位博洛尼亚本地人今年的非凡蜕变表明，这一切都是值得的。
法拉利有“大问题”。别只听我们的一面之词，因为这是刘易斯·汉密尔顿的原话。当队友夏尔·勒克莱尔在赛道外超越他仅被处以非常轻微的5秒罚时，而这在干净空气中行驶很容易就能弥补时，这位英国车手怒火中烧。
在终于拿下他的首个法拉利杆位以及自2023年以来在F1的首个杆位后，汉密尔顿看起来很有希望赢得大奖赛，因为他在最后几圈能够紧追马克斯·维斯塔潘，但由于法拉利引擎相对动力不足，他无法在直道上找到超越的办法。
这不是法拉利今年第一次出现车手之间的火药味，汉密尔顿希望车队在一场看似不太可能的争冠战中更早地支持他，而他和勒克莱尔之间还发生过其他事件，让人感觉两人互相竞争时比对抗其他车队车手还要激烈。
事后，汉密尔顿要求进行“严肃的谈话”，而他肯定会得到这样的机会。正如弗雷德·瓦塞尔在赛后媒体简报会上所说：“车手必须尊重为车队工作的2000名员工。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在与夏尔·勒克莱尔最近一次发生摩擦后，要求在法拉利进行严肃的谈话。
安东内利身上有一种诗意——他正稳步成为同代车手中最出色的一个，与上一代最优秀的两位车手维斯塔潘和汉密尔顿一同登上领奖台。
尽管汉密尔顿会觉得自己本该获胜，这场比赛同样演变成了维斯塔潘的经典胜利——在对手们纷纷痛失好局之际，他从失败的边缘抢走了胜利。
当他的赛车处于应有状态时，维斯塔潘势不可挡。当赛车不在状态时，正如在墨西哥城所发生的那样，他善于抓住机会。这一次，他在起步时超越了法拉利内斗双雄中的一位，又在第28圈唯一一次绿旗维修区进站期间超越了另一位——当时勒克莱尔正坐在那里接受五秒罚停。
从领先位置出发，维斯塔潘承受住了所有压力，一次次挡开汉密尔顿的反复进攻，以一场冷静精准的表现拿下四场比赛中的第三胜。
安东内利和梅赛德斯的差距太大，难以逾越，但中立车迷和荷兰车迷将会对2027赛季从零开始的前景垂涎不已。届时四支顶级车队之间的差距都将像最近几场比赛那样，被压缩在零点三到零点四秒之内。
当车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基今年夏天加入时，他很快发现了凯迪拉克为了首次进入F1发车格而不得不做出的一些取舍，其中可靠性和部件一致性的缺乏是主要致命弱点。
“还有一些捷径是被走过的，这在如此短的时间内组建一支新车队时是不可避免的，”他在九月份表示。“关键在于在一些需要更多关注的领域下功夫。短期内，显然是可靠性。我们已经看到在某些方面我们一直很挣扎，还有就是要把运营卓越性提升到应有的水平，而这目前还不是顶级车队的水平。”
墨西哥站就是最近的一次体现，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和速度不佳的瓦尔特利·博塔斯都不得不在早期处理问题，而博塔斯因左前悬挂断裂撞上1号弯的护栏而退赛。博塔斯幸运地毫发无伤地逃过一劫，但随着凯迪拉克将重心转向2027年，这对F1的第11支车队来说又是一次警钟，事情必须以更高的标准来完成。
博塔斯的席位可能受到威胁，科尔顿·赫塔正在旁等待，而他最近的表现也没给自己加分。但眼下凯迪拉克的问题不在车手。也许它欠这位芬兰人一年时间，让他驾驶一辆始终可驾驶且功能正常的赛车。
如果这就是瓦尔特利·博塔斯的结局，那么这位芬兰人理应得到比一辆功能失调的凯迪拉克首秀赛车更好的待遇。
关于阿斯顿·马丁和本田，已经无需多言，但令人感到残酷和担忧的是，这一年以一辆在澳大利亚无法连续完成超过几圈的赛车开局，而17场比赛过后，我们又回到了同样的境地。
虽然动力单元的性能不可能一夜之间提升，但人们有理由期待本田在可靠性方面取得更大的进步，因为这不是比赛应有的方式。
“你知道，我已经尽了全力，”费尔南多·阿隆索在第六圈因所谓的“动力单元系统压力水平异常”而将他的阿斯顿·马丁赛车停下后，沮丧地说道。一分钟后，他的队友兰斯·斯特罗尔也遭遇了同样的情况。
我跑的每一圈、每天早晨醒来、所做的每一项准备、摄入的食物，一切都聚焦于在方向盘后拿出最佳表现，但我却无法累积足够的圈数。
detailEn: Winners and losers from F1's record-breaking Mexico Grand Prix
As Formula 1 crowned its new king in Mexico, the power unit nightmare of one of the all-time greats keeps going from bad to worse
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Superlatives are running out to describe Kimi Antonelli's unprecedented ascent to power over the 2026 season. At the Mexico Grand Prix, Formula 1's new ruler received the coronation his campaign deserved.
Antonelli's title triumph may have been a foregone conclusion at this point, but that only makes his achievement more remarkable, not less.

It's impossible not to think of his success without thinking about the difficult rookie blues and tough love from the team in 2025, when it felt like there was a real risk the Antonelli experiment was going to teeter off the cliff around the summer. Was it too much, too young, too soon?
Those questions were swiftly put to bed this year as Antonelli took five consecutive wins on his way to sheer domination, including that unforgettable comeback drive from 19th at home in Monza.

Antonelli's coronation in Mexico, in a car that is no longer dominant, was befitting the occasion. As virtually all of his top team rivals got their elbows out, Antonelli drove a mature and low-key race - the only bit of excitement coming when he made a lunge on Charles Leclerc to grab third after the red flag. That move ensured he would celebrate his maiden title on Mexico's famous podium fronting an electric Foro Sol stadium.
On a weekend Mercedes didn't have the upper hand, it was a worthy way to write a fresh chapter of F1 history.

"On the last lap, I just backed off because I just couldn't see the track. I was getting emotional," Antonelli described his tearful title clincher. "I said, 'I'm just going to back off because otherwise I crash here.'"
Kimi Antonelli shares an embrace with Toto Wolff

Antonelli's victory is, of course, not his alone, but that of an army of engineers, mechanics and other staffers across Brackley, Brixworth and F1 paddocks around the world. Cogs in a machine that sputtered during the ground-effect era, but struck back as F1 switched to all-new chassis and power unit regulations for 2026.

Special mention should go to former Mercedes talent scout Gwen Lagrue and to Toto Wolff. Lagrue spotted Antonelli in karting and brought him into the Mercedes young driver program at the age of 12, while Wolff put his money where his mouth is by promoting Antonelli as an 18-year-old to replace Lewis Hamilton. Father Marco also played an instrumental role every step of the way until today.
There were bumps, bruises, broken carbon fibre parts and plenty of teenage tears along the way. But the Bologna native's remarkable transformation this year showed it was all worth it.

Ferrari has "big problems". Don't take our word for it, as those are the words of Lewis Hamilton. The British driver was seething when team-mate Charles Leclerc passing him off the track was only met with a very soft five-second penalty, which was easily offset by running in clear air.

Having finally clinched his first Ferrari pole and his first pole in F1 since 2023, Hamilton looked good value for the grand prix win courtesy of how he was able to hound Max Verstappen over those closing laps, but unable to find a way past on the straight with Ferrari's relatively underpowered engine.

It's not Ferrari's first driver flashpoint this year, with Hamilton wanting the Scuderia to back him sooner in what was an unlikely title challenge, and he and Leclerc having other incidents where it felt the pair raced each other harder than drivers from rival teams.

Afterwards, Hamilton demanded "serious talks" and he is certain to get them. As Fred Vasseur said in his post-race media briefing: "Drivers have to show respect to the 2,000 people working for the team."
Lewis Hamilton is demanding serious talks at Ferrari after his latest flashpoint with Charles Leclerc
There was something poetic about Antonelli - well on his way to become the best driver of his generation, sharing the podium with the best drivers of the previous two in Verstappen and Hamilton.
While Hamilton will feel he should have won, this turned into a vintage Verstappen victory too, snatching victory from the jaws of defeat when his rivals did the opposite.

When his car is where it needs to be, Verstappen is unstoppable. When it is not, as was the case in the Mexican capital, he's opportunistic. This time he picked off one half of the warring Ferrari duo at the start, and the other during the only green flag pitstop on lap 28 as Leclerc sat out his five-second hold.
From the lead Verstappen soaked up all the pressure to swat away Hamilton's repeated advances, delivering a clinical performance to take his third win in four races.

Antonelli's and Mercedes' gap was too big to overcome, but neutral and Dutch fans will be salivating over the prospect of a 2027 season from a blank slate. With four top teams all covered by three to four tenths as was the case in recent races.

When team principal Marcin Budkowski came on board this summer, he was quick to spot some of the tradeoffs Cadillac has had to take to make it into the F1 grid in the first place, with a lack of reliability and parts consistency a major Achilles heel.

"There are also a number of shortcuts that have been taken, which is inevitable when you build a new team in such a time," he said in September. "It’s about working in some areas that need more attention. In the short term, obviously reliability. We’ve seen we’ve struggled with that in some areas, and just getting the operational excellence to the level it should be, which is not the level of a top team as of today."

Mexico was the latest display of that, with both Sergio Perez and an off-the-pace Valtteri Bottas having to manage issues early on, and Bottas crashing out of the race with a front-left suspension collapse that sent him into the barriers at Turn 1. Bottas was lucky to escape with no injuries, but as Cadillac shifts focus on 2027 this is another wake-up call for F1's 11th team that things will have to be done to a higher standard.

Bottas's seat may be under threat with Colton Herta waiting in the wings, and he did himself few favours with his recent performances. But right now Cadillac's problem isn't its drivers. Perhaps it owes the Finn a year in a car that is consistently driveable and functional.
If this is it for Valtteri Bottas, then the Finn deserved better than a dysfunctional Cadillac debut car

Little more has to be said about Aston Martin and Honda, but it feels cruel and worrisome that the year started with a car that couldn't produce more than a handful of consecutive laps in Australia and 17 races later we're back to the same place.
While power unit performance was never going to improve overnight, one could reasonably expect Honda to make bigger strides on the reliability front, because this is no way to go racing.

"I'm doing my best, you know," a disconsolate Fernando Alonso said after parking his Aston Martin within six laps with what was described as "abnormal pressure levels in the PU systems". His team-mate Lance Stroll followed suit a minute later.
"Every lap I do, every morning I wake up, every preparation I do, the food I take in, everything is focused on performing at my best behind the wheel, but I'm not able to accumulate enough laps."
keyPointsZh: 文章将安东内利在2026赛季的崛起称为史无前例，并称墨西哥站是他应得的加冕。
文章同时列出墨西哥大奖赛的赢家与输家，涉及维斯塔潘和红牛。
keyPointsEn: The article calls Antonelli's rise to power in the 2026 season unprecedented and describes Mexico as the coronation his campaign deserved.
The piece lists winners and losers from the Mexico Grand Prix, also involving Verstappen and Red Bull.

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff apologises to George Russell after Mercedes "let him down" at Mexican GP
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫为墨西哥大奖赛中对乔治·罗素的不当表现道歉
托托·沃尔夫承认车队在墨西哥大奖赛中因能量分配问题让乔治·罗素的表现受损
梅赛德斯AMG Petronas F1车队执行董事托托·沃尔夫、乔治·罗素
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说。这里是银箭的最新消息，包括来自Brackley和Brixworth的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队负责人Toto Wolff表示，Brackley车队在墨西哥大奖赛的发车问题让乔治·拉塞尔感到失望。
拉塞尔在发车位置上从第二位起步，仅以0.009秒的差距输给了七冠王刘易斯·汉密尔顿，但在发车时失去了位置。随后，他因为第一圈与红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾发生碰撞而被处以10秒罚时。
尽管拉塞尔的队友基米·安东内利获得了第三名并赢得了他的首个冠军头衔，但拉塞尔却排在第六位。
“我们今天又一次让他失望了，”Wolff在比赛后对天空体育F1说。 “在那个阶段，我们不知道发生了什么。我相信他是在这里为胜利而战，然后出现了这种能量不足的情况，毁了这场比赛。”
“我们有两个车手，但我们没有。这辆车今年对他来说根本不起作用。然后像今天这样的不幸，我们只能为他解决这个问题。”
“这对他是非常困难的一刻；非常、非常、非常困难的一刻。我的目标是提供给他所需的设备和支持，让他为冠军而战。”
“拉塞尔获得第六名意味着他从第二名下滑到第四名，在车手积分榜上。这位英国人现在落后第二名维斯塔潘11分，落后第三名汉密尔顿9分。”
“沃尔夫在赛后向拉塞尔道歉的画面很快在社交媒体上引起了广泛关注。‘我对乔治有了更多的尊重。他处理得很好，真的很优雅。比我强的人’”，一位Reddit上的粉丝评论道。
“我已经数不清Toto这个赛季有多少次要向George道歉了，”另一位粉丝发帖说，同时还有人说：“我真的希望他们能解决这个问题，他明年能回来继续战斗。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff apologises to George Russell after Mercedes "let him down" at Mexican GP
Toto Wolff admitted the team had let George Russell down after an energy deployment issue hampered his Mexican GP
Toto Wolff, Executive Director of Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team, George Russell, Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes Formula 1 team principal Toto Wolff claimed the Brackley outfit "let down" George Russell after a deployment issue spoiled his start at the Mexican Grand Prix.

Russell started from second on the grid after missing out on pole position to seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton by just 0.009 seconds, but he lost ground at the start. He was then given a 10-second penalty for a first-lap collision with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar.
While Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli finished third and claimed his maiden championship title, Russell was left down in sixth.

"We completely let him down today again," Wolff told Sky Sports F1 after the race. "At that stage, we don't know what happened. I believe he was racing for the victory here and then came this lack of energy and ruined his race.
"We have two drivers, we don't have one. The car just didn't work for him this year. And then misfortune like today, we just have to sort it out for him.
"This is a very difficult moment for him; very, very, very difficult moment. My aim is to provide him with the equipment and the support he needs to fight for a championship."

Russell's sixth-place finish meant he slipped from second to fourth in the drivers' standings. The Briton now sits 11 points behind second-placed Max Verstappen and nine points behind third-placed Hamilton.

Footage of Wolff apologising to Russell after the race quickly gained traction on social media. "I have gained a lot of respect for George. It’s gotten away from him, but he’s handled it with a lot of grace, honestly. Better man than me," one fan commented on Reddit.

"I've lost count of the number of times Toto has had to apologise to George this season," another fan posted, while someone else commented: "I really hope they sort it out and he comes back next year fighting."

items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc responds to Lewis Hamilton's call for Ferrari talks after Mexico GP
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔回应刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛后的车队谈话请求
摩纳哥人认为他和他的队友共同负有责任
对于法拉利车迷来说，这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和从马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示刘易斯·汉密尔顿的驾驶“非常接近极限”，同时为自己在墨西哥城大奖赛开赛初段的动作进行辩护。
勒克莱尔在第一圈就向杆位车手汉密尔顿发起了攻击，并在4号弯道成功摆脱了纠缠。
我的意思是，这绝对是一个机会。在1号弯道外侧有一个空隙，我在1号弯道外侧的速度相当快，而2号弯道空间非常有限，这对于赢得比赛当然是预期的。
然后是4号、5号弯道，我和刘易斯都试图非常晚地刹车。我们都没有成功进入弯道。我显然切线了，这最终导致在5号弯道后，马克斯夹在我们中间，这使得情况变得更加复杂。
尽管 stewards（ stewards）后来对勒克莱尔处以5秒罚时，因为他离开赛道并获得了优势，但汉密尔顿也输给了维斯塔潘，维斯塔潘利用这个机会将自己的车提升到第二位。当勒克莱尔在维修区服刑时，维斯塔潘出现在车队的最前方，并最终赢得了比赛。
汉密尔顿事后表示，这次事件让法拉利失去了胜利，并且说“我们肯定得在幕后进行一些严肃的谈话”。
当被问及两人之间是否需要更多的规则时，勒克莱尔表示将会进行一次谈话，但暗示汉密尔顿的挫败感并不一定针对他。
“我们肯定会谈论这件事。我不知道他是否对我所做的事情非常不满，因为我感觉他做的事情也在极限边缘，”他说。
“我认为他可能更多的是对整个情况感到愤怒，关于如何处理四、五次处罚等情况。所以这肯定是我们会谈论的事情。”
勒克莱尔也淡化了这次事件，承认他们两人都犯了一个错误，因为他们为了赛道位置而争斗。
“我们在为胜利而战，所以当然，我和他之间几乎没有余地。最后，我们都犯了一个错误，进入了4号弯，”他说。
“这并不是说我们有什么接触。我们俩都直行，这给了马克斯超车的机会，所以我认为这不应该成为太多讨论的焦点。
“当然很接近，一、二、三非常接近，但我预计我们会争夺领先。四、五，我们都犯了一个错误，我为此付出了代价，受到了处罚。然后你可以争论这是否足够，然后刘易斯在五次中为马克斯付出了代价。”
裁判判定两辆赛车都以过快的速度进入弯道。但他们表示勒克莱尔没有权利要求这个弯道，并且是在赛道外完成的超车。
汉密尔顿在比赛中要求勒克莱尔把位置让回来，但这位摩纳哥车手没有得到法拉利车队的指导来确认这一举动。
“我和车队进行了交谈，并没有得到明确的反馈，我觉得这足以让人困惑，保持位置，我本以为会受到某种处罚，然后我们就付出了代价，”他说。
“我们简要地和车队交谈，试图理解。我问，‘我现在该怎么做？’这总是非常棘手，显然在那个情况下你预期你必须做点什么，但它是第二？第三？第四？嗯，第四可能没有意义，但第二或第三。
“最后我还是坚持了下来。显然，这肯定会在下一次简报中成为讨论的焦点。”
勒克莱尔补充说，他理解为什么会对处罚的大小提出质疑，但他表示规则留给其他选择的余地很小。
“还有规则是写出来的，这也是一个有点困难的事情，就是这种情况，如果你按照规则来，和其他情况并没有那么不同。然而，我确实同意你的观点。有时会有一些场景，你获得的比其他人更多，”他说。
“所以我认为最终我们需要的是不允许我们玩弄那些限制和灰色区域的赛道，因为那样的话，结果会变得有些困难，我相信很多人会以非常糟糕的方式看待它，我理解，但这就是现状。”
问及车手是否在乔治·拉塞尔去年在摩纳哥赛道切弯道后，被警告过类似行为的更严厉处罚，勒克莱尔表示这仅适用于那个赛道。
“在摩纳哥是的，当然是在摩纳哥。我认为这并不是适用于所有赛道的普遍规则，但再次强调，我并不是完全不同意。只是那些规则在某些赛道上，比如今天的赛道，可能会有一些灰色地带，”他说。
“我们知道这一点。我们在周四的车手简报会上和车手们讨论了这个问题。我认为最终的解决方案是拥有一个不允许你这样做赛道的。”
勒克莱尔相信，在比赛前与他的车手们讨论了这个问题后，改变赛道是唯一的真正答案。
“坦白说，我们周四在车手简报会上一直在讨论这个问题，试图弄清楚我们应该如何做出最佳决策。我认为大家的结论可能是，我们首先可能需要改变赛道，确保没有可以冒险的地方或赛道，你可以在内侧采取那么多的风险，”他说。
“如果显然在4号弯出口有一个墙，那么无论是刘易斯还是我都不会把刹车点推得那么远，所以我认为在赛道方面有一些我们可以改进的地方，以便让它变得更简单，否则它非常复杂。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc responds to Lewis Hamilton's call for Ferrari talks after Mexico GP
The Monegasque believes both he and his team-mate were jointly at fault
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Charles Leclerc says Lewis Hamilton’s driving was “very much on the limit” as he defended his own move at the beginning of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
Leclerc attacked polesitter Hamilton at Turn 4 on the opening lap and made it out of the scrap ahead of him.

“I mean, it was definitely an opportunity. In Turn 1 there was a gap on the outside and I had quite a lot of speed around the outside of Turn 1, and there was very little space for Turn 2, which is expected for the win obviously,” Leclerc said.

“And then four, five, Lewis and I both tried to brake very late. We both didn’t make the corner. I obviously cut the track, which eventually then after Turn 5 there was Max in between, which made the situation more confusing.”

While the stewards later gave Leclerc a five-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage, Hamilton also lost out to Verstappen, who used the opportunity to put his car in second. When Leclerc later served the penalty at his pitstop, Verstappen emerged at the front of the pack and eventually won the race.
Hamilton said afterwards that the incident had cost Ferrari the win, and that “we have to have some serious talks behind the scenes for sure”.
Asked whether the pair now needed more rules between them, Leclerc said a conversation would follow, but suggested that Hamilton’s frustrations aren’t necessarily aimed at him.
“We will talk about it obviously. I don’t know if he was very unhappy with what I did, because I felt like it was very much on the limit also what he did,” he said.
“I think he was maybe more angry with the whole situation, how the situation was dealt in four, five with the penalty etc. So this is something we’ll talk about for sure.”
Leclerc also played down the incident, admitting that both had made an error as they fought for track position.
“We are fighting for the win and so of course there’s going to be very little margin left from him and from me. At the end we both did a mistake going into Turn 4,” he said.
“It’s not like we had contact or whatsoever. We both went straight and that gave the opportunity for Max to overtake, so I don’t think it should be that much of a talking point.

“Of course it was close, one, two, three was very close, but I was expecting it to fight for the lead. Four, five, we both made a mistake that I paid with a penalty. Then you can argue whether it’s enough or not, and Lewis then paid out of five with Max.”
The stewards had ruled that both cars had entered the corner with excessive speed. But they said Leclerc was not entitled to claim the corner, and had completed an overtake off the track.
Hamilton had called for Leclerc to hand the place back during the race, but the Monegasque didn’t receive guidance from the Ferrari team to confirm the move.

“Speaking with the team, I didn’t really have a clear feedback, and I think it was just confusing enough to keep the position, and I was expecting some kind of penalty, and then we paid the penalty,” he said.

“We spoke briefly with the team to try and understand. I asked, ‘What should I do now?’ And it’s always very tricky, and obviously in that situation you kind of expect you have to do something, but is it second? Is it third? Is it fourth? Well, fourth probably didn’t make sense, but second or third.
“And at the end I kept going. Obviously it’s going to be a bit of a talking point for sure next briefing.”
Leclerc added that he understood why the size of the penalty was being questioned, but said the rules left little room for anything else.

“There are also rules written, and that’s a bit the difficult thing as well, is that this situation, if you take it by the rule, is not so different to other situations. However, I do agree with you. Sometimes there are scenarios in which you gain more than the other,” he said.

“So I think eventually we just need tracks that doesn’t allow us to play with those kind of limits and grey areas, because then it ends up being a bit of a difficult one, and I’m sure many people will see it in a very bad way, which I understand, but it is the way it is.”
Asked whether drivers had been warned of harsher penalties for similar moves after George Russell cut the chicane in Monaco last year, Leclerc said that had only applied to that circuit.

“In Monaco yes, in Monaco for sure. I don’t think it was a general thing for everywhere, but again, I am not completely disagreeing. It’s just that those rules can have some grey zones on some tracks like today,” he said.
“We knew it. We kind of spoke about it on Thursday with the drivers at the driver briefing. I think that the final solution is to have a track that doesn’t allow you to do that.”
Leclerc believes that changing the circuits is the only real answer, having discussed the issue with his fellow drivers before the race.

“I think, honestly, we’ve been speaking about it all Thursday at the drivers’ briefing, trying to understand in which way should we best take a decision with that. And I think the conclusion of everyone is that we first need probably to change the tracks and make sure that there’s no places or tracks where you can take those amount of risk on the inside,” he said.

“If there was obviously a wall at the exit of Turn 4, neither Lewis or I will have pushed the braking point that much, so I think there’s some things that we can improve track-wise in order to make it more simple, because otherwise it’s very complicated.”
